title: A Pre-Pioneer Incentive Pool operates under bilaterally negotiated rules set in an Ecosystem Accord rather than Atlas terms
content:
A.2.2.9.3.1.4.1 introduces a transitional instrument: "A Pre-Pioneer Incentive Pool is a temporary, chain-specific incentive mechanism designed to bootstrap USDS adoption on a new blockchain before a formal Pioneer Prime is established for that chain. It allows a designated Agent to direct incentive payments to ecosystem partners on that specific chain."

The notable clause is the rule source: "The Pre-Pioneer Incentive Pool may operate under **distinct rules that differ from the standard Pioneer Incentive Pool**, which rules will be specified in an Ecosystem Accord between the respective Agent and Sky Core."

So the terms are not in the Atlas. They live in a bilateral agreement between one Agent and Sky Core, which means the incentive economics of a pre-Pioneer chain are neither uniform across Agents nor readable from the Atlas alone. Everything else in this Article works the opposite way — universal specifications, per-instance parameters ratified by token holder vote, published in Artifacts.

The justification is timing. The formal Pioneer mechanism depends on designation by a chain's official team or foundation (A.2.2.9.3.1.1), which cannot happen before the relationship exists; something must fund the work that creates the relationship. A negotiated instrument fills the gap where no standard terms could yet be right.

Worth flagging because the arrangement's temporariness is the only stated limit on it. The document says it "serves as a transitional phase until the conditions for a formal Pioneer Incentive Pool are met" without specifying a maximum duration or what happens to the Pre-Pioneer Agent when a different Agent later becomes the chain's Pioneer Prime.
description: Before a chain has a formal Pioneer Prime, a designated Agent may direct incentives there under distinct rules agreed between that Agent and Sky Core.
